title: Final pre-release security and verification audit of secret-protection-core

checks.command: cargo +nightly miri test --locked --offline --lib -- <14 syscall-free unit tests>
RUSTFLAGS=-Zsanitizer=address cargo +nightly test --offline --locked --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu -- <4 mlock skips>

findings.title: ClosedSecret::is_closed does not check pages.here() after fork
findings.reproduction: Create a ClosedSecret, call fork(), and inspect closed.is_closed() in the continuing child.
findings.expected: Return false when the buffer belongs to a pre-fork parent, matching is_locked(), is_out_of_dumps(), and is_out_of_children().
findings.observed: is_closed() checks only self.access == Access::Nothing and returns true in a child whose parent pages were unmapped or wiped.
findings.impact: Minor post-fork status inconsistency; calling read/write/push/truncate in the child still aborts before dereferencing.
findings.recommendedFix: Check self.secret.pages.here() && self.access == Access::Nothing in ClosedSecret::is_closed().
findings.requiredVerification: Extend secret_memory fork check and run cargo test --test secret_memory on Linux and macOS.

findings.title: docs/COVERAGE.md references pre-commit working tree instead of 2747028f
findings.reproduction: Compare docs/COVERAGE.md:7 against git rev-parse HEAD (2747028f4452c3e36f2a500eabdbc795010bf295).
findings.observed: References the working tree following c0c472af2327cc55a561881201db9830613bd3fc even though fingerprint db750b50... matches 2747028f.
findings.impact: Minor traceability lag in coverage documentation.

findings.title: THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md omits explicit crate names for enumflags2_derive and thiserror-impl
findings.reproduction: Cross-check all 14 third-party packages in Cargo.lock against THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
findings.expected: List every locked package name and version explicitly.
findings.observed: enumflags2_derive 0.7.12 and thiserror-impl 2.0.21 are referred to collectively as the macros of enumflags2 and thiserror.
findings.impact: Minor completeness gap in notice inventory.
findings.recommendedFix: Add enumflags2_derive 0.7.12 and thiserror-impl 2.0.21 explicitly to THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
findings.requiredVerification: Compare Cargo.lock package list against THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

findings.title: Release metadata (publish = false, draft notice, Unreleased changelog) remains in draft state
findings.reproduction: Inspect Cargo.toml, README.md, CHANGELOG.md, and run cargo package --list.
findings.expected: Versioned changelog heading, accurate review/status notice, and package metadata if publishing to crates.io.
findings.observed: Cargo.toml sets publish = false without documentation/repository metadata; README.md keeps the pre-review draft banner; CHANGELOG.md lists changes under Unreleased.
findings.impact: Non-blocking for Git tag/workspace use; required before crates.io publication.
findings.recommendedFix: Promote Unreleased changelog items under the release version and UTC date when tagging, and update README/Cargo.toml as appropriate.

observations.title: tests/worker.rs is at 790 LOC, 10 lines below CORE-15's 800-line file limit
observations.evidence: Line count analysis excluding blank and comment-only lines: 790 LOC (977 raw lines).
observations.reproduction: Count non-blank, non-comment lines in tests/worker.rs.
observations.expected: Files remain within CORE-15's 800 LOC limit.
observations.observed: 790 LOC leaves 10 lines before hitting the 800 LOC limit.
observations.impact: Next addition to tests/worker.rs will likely require splitting into tests/worker/main.rs and submodules.
observations.recommendedFix: Split tests/worker.rs into submodules when adding further worker tests.

remediation.evidence: a_program_without_a_setting_keeps_what_it_inherited passed on Linux, AArch64, macOS; setting fuzzer 872,494 runs.
Accepted in docs/TECHNICAL.md; a_stray_client_does_not_stop_the_start passed on Windows CI.
without_null passed on Linux x86-64 and AArch64.
a_child_of_fork_leaves_the_buffers_of_its_parent_alone passed on Linux x86-64, AArch64, and macOS.
a_worker_closes_what_its_parent_names_and_nothing_else passed on Linux x86-64, AArch64, and macOS.
src/protect.rs and src/os/windows.rs clarify AppContainer token policy evidence.
secret_memory verifies child PID, waitpid, WIFEXITED, and fd range 3..=255.
tests/support/run.rs propagates skips and partial checks.
served_here checks GetNamedPipeServerProcessId; passed on windows-latest CI.
30s worker linger and bounded retries passed across all local and CI runs.
README.md, src/protect.rs, and src/os.rs state WebAssembly lacks guard pages.
src/protect.rs and docs/TECHNICAL.md state WerSetFlags(NOHEAP) is not read back.
docs/audits/README.md errata link old snapshots and document current behavior.

limitations: Android (aarch64-linux-android) and iOS (aarch64-apple-ios) targets are compiled and Clippy-checked with -D warnings, but not executed at runtime.
59 lines (2.59%) uncovered in Linux x86-64 llvm-cov are OS allocation/syscall failure branches, 4 GiB+ frame guards, and the second in-process serve() return.

Raw clone(2) bypassing pthread_atfork, pre-fork borrowed slices used in a continuing child, pre-isolation attached debuggers, external PID namespaces, and microarchitectural side channels remain outside the documented threat model in docs/TECHNICAL.md.
